scripts.start: powershell -Command "Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/k cd /d \"E:\Workplace\Cyphersol\ca_offline_multiple_clones\beta_testers_ca\frontend\" && npm run electron' -Verb runAs"
scripts.start:electron: cross-env NODE_ENV=development wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron main.js
scripts.start-all: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run start:fastapi" "npm run start:react" "npm run start"
scripts.sync-version: node -e "delete require.cache[require.resolve('dotenv')];const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');delete process.env.APP_VERSION;require('dotenv').config({path:'./.env'});const envPath=path.resolve('./.env');const envContent=fs.readFileSync(envPath,'utf8');console.log('📋 Raw .env file content shows APP_VERSION:',envContent.match(/APP_VERSION=(.+)/)?.[1] || 'NOT FOUND');const v=process.env.APP_VERSION;console.log('📋 APP_VERSION fetched from .env:',v);if(!v){console.error('❌ APP_VERSION not found in .env');process.exit(1);}const updateJson=(file,key)=>{const p=path.resolve(file);const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));d[key]=v;fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(d,null,2));console.log('✅ Updated',file,'version to',v);};updateJson('./package.json','version');updateJson('./react-app/package.json','version');const splash=fs.readFileSync('./react-app/splash.html','utf8').replace(/Version \d+\.\d+\.\d+/g,'Version '+v);fs.writeFileSync('./react-app/splash.html',splash);console.log('✅ Updated splash.html version to',v);const dash=fs.readFileSync('./react-app/src/components/MainDashboardComponents/MainDashboard.js','utf8').replace(/v\d+\.\d+\.\d+/g,'v'+v);fs.writeFileSync('./react-app/src/components/MainDashboardComponents/MainDashboard.js',dash);console.log('✅ Updated MainDashboard.js version to',v);console.log('🎯 All versions synced to:',v);"
scripts.build: npm run sync-version && npx rimraf dist && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:react && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:fast: npm run sync-version && npx rimraf dist && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:react && electron-builder --config.compression=store
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run deploy
